newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - After-hours activity quiet.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - After-hours activity quiet.

text.p: Stocks did not move much in after-hours trading on Monday, traders said.
"It was quiet. It should be a quiet week," a trader said.

Shortly before the markets closed, shares of Philip Morris Cos Inc soared up 3-1/8 to 105-1/2 on news that David Kessler, chief of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and a vocal tobacco regulator, will leave his post in early 1997.

The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 18,300 shares compared to 10,300 shares on Friday. Session two volume was 23,295,733 shares compared to 2,998,600 shares on Friday, the NYSE said.
